name: sonar
description: A status line for the Claude Desktop Code tab: context, usage limits with their pace, prompt cache, repo and branch, cost — no tokens used

language.title: Language
language.description: Display language; auto follows the system locale

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: Time format; auto = 12h for en-US, 24h elsewhere

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: Default placement (/sonar can change it per user)

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: Comma-separated, in any order of: context, quotas, cache, repo, cost

paceWarn.title: Pace warning (points)
paceWarn.description: Points ahead of an even pace turning a limit orange

paceAlert.title: Pace alert (points)
paceAlert.description: Points ahead of an even pace turning a limit red

quotaWarn.title: Limit warning (%)
quotaWarn.description: Usage turning a limit orange whatever the pace

quotaAlert.title: Limit alert (%)
quotaAlert.description: Usage turning a limit red whatever the pace

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branches flagged with a warning

quotaLog.title: Usage limit log
quotaLog.description: Append a JSON line to a local file whenever the 5h or 7d usage % (or its reset time) changes; off by default

quotaLogPath.title: Usage limit log file
quotaLogPath.description: Path of that JSONL file; empty = ~/.claude/sonar/quota-log.jsonl
